channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ted Leonsis | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ted Leonsis from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Bartelstein on Ted Leonsis, Michael Winger
item.description:
“This was an extremely complicated process with so many different hurdles to get through and Ted Leonsis and Michael Winger were unbelievable partners in making this happen,”

Mark Bartelstein on Ted Leonsis, Michael Winger, Jun 18, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Wes Unseld Jr on Ted Leonsis
item.description:
“I want to thank Tommy and Mr. Leonsis for the opportunity to lead this talented team both on and off the court and to continue moving the franchise in a positive direction,”

Wes Unseld Jr on Ted Leonsis, Jul 17, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Sashi Brown on Ted Leonsis
item.description:
Brown said there are plans to build out a more robust analytics operation for the defending-champion Mystics.

“Having data be part of the information that we consider when we are making these really important decisions and complex decisions, is I think a wise practice and something we fully embrace from Ted Leonsis and his partnership group all the way on down,”

Sashi Brown on Ted Leonsis, Feb 23, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Tommy Sheppard on Ted Leonsis, Davis Bertans
item.description:
Fred Katz:Sheppard on Bertans:

“When somebody tells me this is where they want to be, I take em at face value for that... His agent, Ted Leonsis and everyone on down, everyone in our organization has made it clear: 'Davis, this is a great place for you and you've been great for us.’”

Tommy Sheppard on Ted Leonsis, Davis Bertans, Feb 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Ted Leonsis
item.description:
Fred Katz:Bradley Beal on owner Ted Leonsis recently confirming that the Wizards will never tank:

“Tanking is not in my vocabulary. And it damn sure ain’t in Ted’s. He’s paying luxury dollars. Tanking don’t exist.”

Bradley Beal on Ted Leonsis, Feb 1, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Ted Leonsis
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Ted Leonsis saying the Wizards will never, ever tank:

“My job and our team's job is to go out there and give great effort. And I think we have been doing that.”

Scott Brooks on Ted Leonsis, Jan 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Flip Saunders on Ted Leonsis
item.description:
“I was a proponent from day one of changing that whole atmosphere. Having been in situations where we had success in both Detroit and in Minnesota, we didn’t have that… When I was there, I made my feelings pretty well known. And actually when I left — and had meetings with Ted Leonsis when I left — I pretty much said the same thing: that the team is not gonna take any type of steps until you clean out some of that knucklehead — like you said — the knucklehead factor and get everyone more on the same page.”

Flip Saunders on Ted Leonsis, Mar 5, 2013. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Wes Unseld on Ted Leonsis
item.description:
Unseld said.

“He didn't strip me. I had no special rights to any season tickets. I always had season tickets, but that was Mr. Pollin, that had nothing to do with Mr. Leonsis. He never said [anything], and I never asked for tickets. So there's nothing. Guys, I haven't spoken to Peter Vecsey in 25 years, so I wouldn't know where he's getting this stuff. He didn't have to take them; they were already his.... I don't know anything about taking tickets.”

Wes Unseld on Ted Leonsis, Jan 5, 2011. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Wes Unseld on Ted Leonsis
item.description:
“He has to run his business however he thinks he has to run his business, so I don't take it as a personal affront. He and I have met on occasions, I've been over to do little things with him and for him, so there's no situation here....[Leonsis has] been very kind to me. So I've got no problem with any of that.”

Wes Unseld on Ted Leonsis, Jan 5, 2011. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Wes Unseld on Ted Leonsis
item.description:
But Unseld repeatedly said that there is no story here, no ill will, and no stripping.

“Mr. Leonsis has a business to run, and nobody understands that better than I do,”

Wes Unseld on Ted Leonsis, Jan 5, 2011. Source: Washington Post.
